integrity: The complete infinite proof is mathematical, with row-column palette inequalities and explicit constructions. Finite code merely cross-checks the proof. There is no independent mathematical certification, and source limitations are explicitly disclosed.
scientific_limitations: All integer dimensions at least two; two distinct singleton colors; only the minimum weight is classified, not all minimizers. General graph products and other numbers of colors remain open here. Historical priority is provisional, especially against an inaccessible introductory dual-server article.
title: Exact singleton two-rainbow domination of rectangular rook graphs
